operaciones.metaDescription: Tools for your videos: trim, shrink, variants, publishing and rights.
operaciones.title: Operations
operaciones.description: A suite of tools to work on your videos without going through the analysis. Each one is its own page; whatever you order lands in Projects as one more job.

recortar.descripcion: Keep one stretch of the video, as is, with no analysis or reframing.

reducir.descripcion: The same video, lighter. You choose how much to give up.

variantes.descripcion: From one clip, several versions that are different content: another hook, another length, another format, other captions, another cover.

publicacion.descripcion: Title, description and hashtags per network: the template your project’s clips go out with.

variantes.title: Variants
variantes.description: From one clip, several versions that are different content: another hook, another length, another format, other captions, another cover. Each one lands in Projects as one more job. What changes is what people see; the file is never disguised.

variantes.duracionesHint: Seconds of each version from its hook; if the video ends sooner, up to the end.
variantes.formatosHint: One per destination: 9:16 for TikTok and Reels, 1:1 and 4:5 for the feed, 16:9 for YouTube and X.
variantes.portadaHint: Each version opens on the image of its own hook; without this, all of them on the start of the video.
variantes.total: {n, plural, =0 {No variants} one {# variant} other {# variants}}
variantes.totalHint: Every combination of hook, length, format and captions is a version. At most {max}.

variantes.encargadoHint: They show in Projects, each with its label and progress.
variantes.bloqueado: Variants is available from the {plan} plan.

publicacion.title: Publishing
publicacion.description: A project’s template per network: the title, description and hashtags Clipealo publishes its clips with on each account. A single clip can break away from it on its own card. None of this touches the file.
